bullets: Designed and developed scalable web applications using React and Node.js with ExpressJS and NestJS.
Built and optimized RESTful APIs across distributed systems using TypeORM for data modeling and database interaction.
Migrated legacy SOAP-based APIs to modern REST services to improve interoperability and maintainability.
Integrated AI-powered application support using Claude/OpenAI and LangChain for natural-language ERP workflows.
Developed an embedded AI assistant that provides step-by-step guidance inside the ERP web application.
Implemented Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines to retrieve documentation, knowledge base content, and internal guides.
Designed prompt orchestration and context strategies to improve response relevance, accuracy, and usability.
Secured WebSocket connections and enforced role-based authorization using NestJS guards.
Developed a Call Center Portal using Node.js, NestJS, TypeORM, MySQL, TypeScript, Vue.js, and Vuetify.
Implemented OAuth 2.0 authentication and authorization with role-based access controls.
Designed and optimized backend services, endpoints, middleware, and service modules to support business logic and microservices.
Implemented WebSocket-based real-time communication for instant updates without page refreshes.
Used Microsoft DevOps tools across planning, deployment, and full development lifecycle management.
Designed, implemented, and tested Azure Serverless Functions in C# to extend system capabilities.
Integrated external APIs for dynamic search, filtering, and data workflows.
Managed application databases using SQL Server Management Studio.
Designed intuitive user interfaces with XAML for engaging user experiences.
Used Microsoft Azure for secure storage and management of web and mobile application data.
Built high-performance websites with React, JavaScript, Bootstrap, Vue.js, CSS, HTML, Angular, ASP.NET, and C#.
Implemented cross-platform and platform-specific features in C# using Xamarin and dependency injection patterns.
Designed, coded, enhanced, and tested cross-platform applications from frontend to backend.
Built a team site using JavaScript, Bootstrap, Vue.js, HTML, and CSS.
Developed applications that allow customers to place and track orders.
Used Selenium to run automation tests on the Hamper website.
